verses.1: When he saw the crowd, he went up to the mountain. Once he sat down, his disciples came to him.
verses.2: And when he opened his mouth, he taught them, saying:
verses.3: Alas, those who are poor in spirit, for it is their kingdom that lies in heaven.
verses.4: Those who mourn are blessed, for they will be called upon to participate in the ceremony.
verses.5: The teachers are better, for they will inherit the earth.
verses.6: Those who suffer and endure hardships for justice, they deserve to be rewarded.
verses.7: The more righteous they are, the more they will be rewarded.
verses.8: The more righteous those people are in their hearts, the more they will be able to see God.
verses.9: The more fortunate are those who are called “heavenly beings”; they are indeed children of God.
verses.10: Those who are bound by justice are blessed, for they possess the kingdom of heaven.
verses.11: It will be better if they honor you, and if they drive away all those who do evil against you. They will then say that it’s all because of me that they suffer such harm.
verses.12: Rejoice and be glad, that your wages are great in heaven. For this reason did God curse those prophets before you.
verses.13: We are like the dust on the surface of the earth. If the dust were to be removed, where would it go? It doesn’t matter whether it’s not thrown out into the open by humans at all.
verses.14: We are the light of the world. No city can hide itself above a mountain.
verses.15: They also cover it with a canopy and decorations, not on top of it, but right on the canopy itself. It shines brightly for everyone who is inside the house.
verses.16: May the light shine before you, so that people can see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
verses.17: Do not think that we came to break the law or the prophets’ teachings. We did not come to break them, but to fulfill them.
verses.18: Indeed, I say to you, until heaven and earth pass away, not one hair shall fall from off the head of one who obeys the law.
verses.19: He who fulfills one of these commands and teaches people in this way will be called the least important in the kingdom of heaven. But he who does and teaches even more, will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.20: I say to you that if justice did not exceed that of the officials and the Pharisees, then you would not have been able to enter the kingdom of heaven.
verses.21: You heard that the ancients spoke out against this. Do not commit murder. Those who do commit murder will be held accountable in court.
verses.22: I say to you that every person who becomes angry with his brother shall be responsible for the judgment. Whoever says something to his brother shall also be responsible for that. Raca, he shall be responsible for the assembly. And whoever says anything else, he shall be responsible for the fire itself.
verses.23: If you then offer your gift at the altar, remember that your brother has something of yours as well.
verses.24: You should place your gift in front of the altar. First, give it to your brother as a gift. Then, after that, you can bring your gift forward.
verses.25: I will quickly bring the evidence of your accusation to you, until I am with him on that road. In any case, don’t let the accuser deliver me to the judge, or to the officer who will throw me into prison.
verses.26: I say to you, do not leave there until you have received the last payment.
verses.27: You heard that it was announced: Do not deceive me.
verses.28: I say to you that anyone who sees a woman and desires her, has already enticed her in his heart.
verses.29: But if your right eye causes you to stumble, remove it and cast it away from you. It’s better for you that one of your members be killed, rather than all of your body be destroyed.
verses.30: And if your right hand gives you trouble, cut it off and throw it away from you. It’s better for you to have one of your followers killed, rather than losing your entire flock.
verses.31: He agreed that whoever divorces his wife should give her a dowry.
verses.32: I say to you that anyone who divorces his wife on the grounds of adultery commits adultery against her. And whoever marries a woman after she has been divorced commits adultery as well.
verses.33: Once again, you heard that the ancients had made such a decision. You won’t insist anymore; instead, you will return the oaths you gave to your lord.
verses.34: But I say to you, do not think that everything is the same. Nor in heaven, for that is also a place where God resides.
verses.35: Neither in the city, since it is a place where his feet rest; nor in Jerusalem, since it is a city belonging to the great king.
verses.36: Neither in your head do you know how to make one white hair or black.
verses.37: Let your words be good and pleasing to God. But most of them are actually evil in nature.
verses.38: You heard that it was said: “An eye instead of an eye, and a tooth instead of a tooth.”
verses.39: I say to you, do not resist the evil one. Instead, when he leads you to the right side, then turn away from him as well.
verses.40: And if he wants to judge you, then take away his clothes as well.
verses.41: And whenever someone tries to lead you away, two people should accompany me.
verses.42: Ask for it from him, and those who wish to borrow from you should not leave without returning it.
verses.43: You heard that it was said: “Love your neighbor, and hate your enemy.”
verses.44: But I say to you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.
verses.45: So that you may become sons of your heavenly father. For he divides the sun between the good and the evil, and he punishes the righteous and the unjust.
verses.46: For if you truly love those who love you, then why do you have any hatred in your hearts? After all, even those who do this same thing also do it willingly.
verses.47: And if you only defend your own brothers, what more can you do? After all, even the other nations do the same thing.
verses.48: Therefore, you should become perfect just as your heavenly father is perfect.
